_comment: DV-200 is the server's form: the person who hands the papers to the restrained person completes items 5 to 7 and signs it, so every one of those fields is courtUse with a _why saying so. The filer pre-fills only what identifies the case - the two names (items 1 and 2), the court, and the list of papers in item 4 the packet knows it is serving. Each of those carries the name of the answer that already decides it, so DV-200 asks nothing new: it is in the packet because DV-100's sheriff question was answered No, and that No ticks 4a and 4b; DV-100's custody box ticks 4c.

fields.label: Case number
fields._why: DV-200 prints "Court clerk fills in case number when form is filed." case_number is courtUse on every form in the packet: there is no case number until the court files DV-100, so no form asks it.

fields.label: 1. Name of party asking for protection
2. Name of party to be restrained
4a. DV-109 with DV-100 and a blank DV-120
fields._why: DV-200 is in the packet only because DV-100's "Do you want the sheriff or marshal to serve the papers ... for free?" was answered No - someone else serves - and DV-109 with DV-100 and a blank DV-120 are always served, so the No of that answer (papers_served_by_sheriff_no) ticks the box. The filer pre-fills it; the server signs that they gave them.

fields.label: 4b. DV-110 (Temporary Restraining Order)
fields._why: DV-110 always travels with DV-109 (the spec activates it unconditionally) and is always served, so the same No ticks it.

fields.label: 4c. DV-105 and DV-140 (child custody and visitation)
fields._why: DV-105 and DV-140 are in the packet exactly when DV-100's custody box is ticked, and that box carries this name (DV-140 item 3 uses it the same way), so one answer ticks it.

fields.label: 4d. FL-150 with a blank FL-150
fields._why: Ticked when FL-150 is in the packet - DV-100 asks for child or spousal support - because the packet serves it (computed in dv200-hints.json).

fields.label: 4e. FL-155 with a blank FL-155
fields._why: FL-155 is not made by this packet yet (formsStillToBuild in the spec), so nothing here knows it is served; the server ticks it at service.

fields.label: 4f. DV-115 (Request to Continue Hearing)
fields._why: DV-115 is served later in a case, not with this packet; the server ticks it at that service, so it stays blank here.

fields.label: 4g. DV-116 (Order on Request to Continue Hearing)
fields._why: DV-116 is served later in a case, not with this packet; the server ticks it at that service, so it stays blank here.

fields.label: 4h. DV-130 (Restraining Order After Hearing)
fields._why: DV-130 is served later in a case, not with this packet; the server ticks it at that service, so it stays blank here.

fields.label: 4i. Other documents served
fields._why: RA-010 is served with the packet when the filer will attend by phone or video, and no box in 4a-4h names it; 4i does (computed in dv200-hints.json).

fields.label: 4i. Other documents served (specify)
fields._why: RA-010 is served with the packet when the filer will attend by phone or video, and no box in 4a-4h names it; 4i does (computed in dv200-hints.json).
